summary.text: Tom Forest is the Democratic candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 31, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Darcey Edwards (R).
Forest is a software engineer who, in a Ballotpedia survey, said he has served on the Banks School District Budget Committee for 15 years.

paragraphs.text: Tom Forest earned a high school diploma from Hillsboro High School and a bachelor's degree from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 1986.
His listed career experience is as a software engineer.
In his survey, he said he has chaired the Banks School District Budget Committee for the last few years.
Forest advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.

In his survey, he said he would raise revenue in a progressive way, starting with basing corporate taxes on worldwide combined reporting, and would prioritize funding schools and funding or removing unfunded mandates.
